# mk_graphql

> A clean, modern, simplified GraphQL client for Dart & Flutter with a normalized cache, auth/token-refresh handling, stale-while-revalidate, request dedup, retry with backoff, and automatic pagination. Operations are typically generated by `mk_graphql_generator` from `.graphql` files, and executed at runtime through `GraphQLClient` from this package.

If you are an AI coding agent integrating `mk_graphql` into an app, read [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/main/packages/mk_graphql/llms-full.txt) first — it is self-contained and does not require fetching anything else. The links below are for deeper reference on a specific topic.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://github.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/blob/main/docs/mk_graphql/getting-started.md): install, construct `GraphQLClient`, run your first query/mutation, handle errors, refetch, paginate, subscribe.
- [Client, Requests & Responses](https://github.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/blob/main/docs/mk_graphql/client-and-requests.md): `GraphQLRequest`/`GraphQLResponse` shapes, `GraphQLClient` API table, `FetchPolicy`, `ErrorPolicy`, default headers, dedup, retry/backoff, exception types.
- [Authentication & Token Storage](https://github.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/blob/main/docs/mk_graphql/authentication.md): `TokenPair`, `TokenStorage.i`, login/refresh/logout semantics, the silent-refresh distinction, revoke listeners.
- [Caching](https://github.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/blob/main/docs/mk_graphql/caching.md): the `Cache` interface, `InMemoryCache` normalization, optimistic responses, stale-while-revalidate, `invalidateQueries`, `HiveCache` persistence.
- [Pagination](https://github.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/blob/main/docs/mk_graphql/pagination.md): `fetchMore`, `GraphQLPaginator` (offset/page/cursor factories), `flutter_bloc` integration.
- [Link Pipeline](https://github.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/blob/main/docs/mk_graphql/links.md): `AuthLink`, `TypenameLink`, `LoggerLink`, transport links (`DioLink`, `HttpLink`, `SseLink`, `WebSocketLink`, `BatchLink`), and how to customize the pipeline.
- [Package README](https://github.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/blob/main/packages/mk_graphql/README.md): overview and quick links.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/blob/main/packages/mk_graphql/CHANGELOG.md): version history.
- [pub.dev package page](https://pub.dev/packages/mk_graphql): published versions, API reference (dartdoc).

## Optional

- [mk_graphql_generator](https://github.com/kishormainali/mk_graphql/blob/main/docs/mk_graphql_generator/getting-started.md): a `build_runner` builder that generates typed `GraphQLRequest` subclasses and response models from `.graphql` operation/schema files, so you don't hand-write the `GraphQLRequest` boilerplate described in the docs above. Not required — `mk_graphql`'s runtime works with hand-written `GraphQLRequest` subclasses too — but recommended for any non-trivial schema.
